derivation: contract C2 `hreflang_canonical_not_self`: A has hreflang alternates and its resolved canonical is B's url; A2 emits it once for the page. B resolves canonical to itself; reciprocity for en holds both ways.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
</head><body></body></html>
files.b.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>
